correctness.rationale: Hypergeometric selection of exactly four broken cyclic edges gives the explicit quartic two-point covariance. Its cyclic Laplacian yields every Fourier eigenvalue, including the zero mode by exact sums. Positivity and unimodal spectral ordering hold for all n>=5. General rational inequalities cover the two infinite ranges; 5<=n<=13 are verified by rigorous rational sine intervals, not float tests. verify.py passed symbolic identities, rational boundary classifications, general coefficient sign checks, and independent covariance DFT comparisons. The proof covers all positive integer lengths stated and keeps normalization fixed.

value.rationale: A fixed four-domain-wall ring is a natural microcanonical low-energy shell of the finite Ising model, and coordinate Walsh functions represent its first-order measurements. Complete all-length Riesz bounds and eigenvalues are meaningful for spatial observability and sampling, particularly the exact distinct changeovers of maximizing and minimizing modes at n=12 and n=8 and the dimension-dependent quadratic instability. This is a structural classification, not merely a routine isolated table entry; no extension to arbitrary wall counts is claimed.
